title: Mystery Lurking in the Giant Tower

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: While Labyrista was busy analyzing the tower, the climb with Vampy and {0} at her side continued.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ラビリスタは塔の解析を進めながら、
ヴァンピィ、{0}と塔を登っていた。

text_block_list.name: Vampy
text_block_list.text: But... it's just weird that there's stars inside of a tower! Bloodkin, surely you think the same, right?
text_block_list.orig_text:
でも、
塔の中にお星さまがあるなんて変なの！
けんぞくもそーおもうよね？

text_block_list.name: Labyrista
text_block_list.text: Boy, don't you remember? The top of the Tower of Sol had a similar atmosphere.
text_block_list.orig_text:
少年なら覚えてるかな？
ソルの塔の頂上も
こんな雰囲気だったからね。

text_block_list.name: Labyrista
text_block_list.text: Judging from the name: "Tower of Luna", I believe this structure must've been based on the Tower of Sol.
text_block_list.orig_text:
「ルナの塔」って名前からしても、
元になったのはソルの塔で間違いないと思う。

text_block_list.name: Labyrista
text_block_list.text: That said, "Sun" in contrast to "Moon", huh... What a meaningful name they've given it.
text_block_list.orig_text:
だけど、
「太陽」に対して「月」か……
まーた意味ありげな名前つけてくれちゃって。

text_block_list.name: Labyrista
text_block_list.text: Before the "Reconstruction", there was no trace of this place. It was probably, or rather, definitely, created after that happened.
text_block_list.orig_text:
『再構築』される前は、
影も形もなかった。
おそらく、
というか確実に
アレが起きた後に造られたものだろうね。

text_block_list.name: Labyrista
text_block_list.text: However, why or who did it... I have no clue.
text_block_list.orig_text:
だけど、
誰が何のために……
ってところがさっぱり不明でさ。

text_block_list.name: Labyrista
text_block_list.text: When it comes to people capable of constructing structures of this magnitude, it's possible to narrow down the number of possible culprits to a certain extent.
text_block_list.orig_text:
これだけ大規模な建造物を造れる人物となると、
ある程度の人数までは絞って推測できる。

text_block_list.name: Labyrista
text_block_list.text: If that was the case, I wouldn't have come all the way to investigate it would I...? ...No, maybe I'm just having a memory mishap, and I'm actually the one who built it...!?
text_block_list.orig_text:
それならわざわざ調査に来ないでしょ～
……いや、
記憶が飛んでるだけで、
本当はアタシが！？

text_block_list.name: Vampy
text_block_list.text: Labyrista, so you can create a building this big? Amazing!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ラビリスタ、
こんなおっきい建物つくれるの？
すっごーい！

text_block_list.name: Labyrista
text_block_list.text: No, no, I'm just kidding! I haven't, you know?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
いやいや、
冗談だから！　
やらないよ！？

text_block_list.name: Labyrista
text_block_list.text: It's not like I cannot create something equivalent to this, but even so, it's not the kind of effort I'd put in without a purpose.
text_block_list.orig_text:
似たようなことならできなくもないけどさぁ。
それでも、
目的も無しに払えるような労力じゃないって。

text_block_list.name: Labyrista
text_block_list.text: Mana did? Hmmm... I wonder about that.
text_block_list.orig_text:
真那が？　
いやー、
それはどうだろう。

text_block_list.name: Labyrista
text_block_list.text: It was Mana who built the infrastructure in the city of Landosol. He's quite an efficiency-oriented guy.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ランドソルの街にインフラを整えたりしたのって真那だし。
結構効率主義なとこあるんだよねアイツ。

text_block_list.name: Labyrista
text_block_list.text: "My, what a good place to gaze down at those vermins. Bring my throne up here to the top. I'll live here from today." Do you picture him saying something like that? ...I can see it.
text_block_list.orig_text:
「あら、
愚民を眺めるのにちょうどいいわね。
頂上に玉座を運びなさい。
今日からここに住むわ」
とか言うと思う？　
アタシ相手なら言いそう？　
……確かに。

text_block_list.name: Labyrista
text_block_list.text: Besides, and this is just my intuition speaking, but... I have a feeling that this Tower was designed to benefit you, Boy.
text_block_list.orig_text:
それに、
これはアタシの直感だけど……
この塔は少年のためになるよう設計されてるフシがある。

text_block_list.name: Labyrista
text_block_list.text: I can't imagine Mana would go out of his way to build something like that. Yeah, I guess there's really no point in thinking Mana built it.
text_block_list.orig_text:
真那がわざわざそんなことすると思えないし。
やっぱり真那が造ったって線はほぼないんじゃないかな。

text_block_list.name: Labyrista
text_block_list.text: Haha♪ That sounds pretty cool!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ははっ♪　
そいつはなかなか愉快だね！

text_block_list.name: Labyrista
text_block_list.text: If we think along those lines... maybe someone capable of building some kind of super technology came from beyond the sky and built it just to pass the time?
text_block_list.orig_text:
その線で考えるなら……
空の彼方から超技術を持った誰かさんがやってきて、
暇つぶしに造っていったとか？

text_block_list.name: Labyrista
text_block_list.text: And all that was left from that time-killing activity was this Tower of Luna... "A mysterious structure left behind on the continent of Astraea! The investigation team set foot into it to solve its mystery...!"
text_block_list.orig_text:
そして残されたのがこのルナの塔……
「アストライア大陸に残された謎の建造物！
調査隊はその謎を解き明かすべく足を踏み入れた……！」

text_block_list.name: Labyrista
text_block_list.text: ...No, I'm sorry! I was just joking! Don't look at me with such cold eyes!
text_block_list.orig_text:
……いや、
ごめんって！
冗談で言ってみただけだってば！
そんな冷たい目で見ないでよ～！

text_block_list.name: Labyrista
text_block_list.text: It's just... there's monsters inside this tower. No, the fact that they've been "placed" here is a bit concerning.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ただ
ここには魔物がいる……
いや、
「配置」されてるのは気になるところだね。

text_block_list.name: Labyrista
text_block_list.text: As you surely know, Boy, to enter this tower, you have to activate some kind of transport magic. You can't just stroll in and out like it's nothing.
text_block_list.orig_text:
少年も知っての通り、
塔に入るには転送魔法の発動が必須だ。
普通に出入りするのはまず不可能。

text_block_list.name: Labyrista
text_block_list.text: ...So then, where did those monsters come from?
text_block_list.orig_text:
……じゃあ、
魔物たちはどこから来たのか？

text_block_list.name: Labyrista
text_block_list.text: There's no way they'd just spawn from nowhere, which means it's only natural to assume someone put them here.
text_block_list.orig_text:
まさか無からニュルっと生まれるわけないし、
そうなると誰かが配置したって考えるのが自然でしょ。

text_block_list.name: Labyrista
text_block_list.text: And the way stronger enemies start appearing as the upper floors unlock... it's basic level design.
text_block_list.orig_text:
それに上層が解放されていくにつれ、
強力な敵に置き換えられていくレベルデザイン……

text_block_list.name: Labyrista
text_block_list.text: I believe there's an intent behind such a design. Why is this tower connected to your memories, Boy? Who did this, and for what purpose...?
text_block_list.orig_text:
設計には理由と意図がある。
この塔が、
少年の記憶に関わっているのはなぜだ？
誰が
何の目的で……

text_block_list.name: Labyrista
text_block_list.text: ...Hmm, it's no good! There's just not enough pieces to form a proper hypothesis!
text_block_list.orig_text:
……うーん、
ダメだ～！
仮説を立てるための鍵が少なすぎる！

text_block_list.name: Labyrista
text_block_list.text: I feel that there's some kind of intent behind the design of this tower, though... Right now, it's impossible to piece together why.
text_block_list.orig_text:
塔の設計に何らかの意図は感じるけれど……
現時点だと、
その解読までは難しいなぁ。

text_block_list.name: Labyrista
text_block_list.text: Well, I suppose there's a vast difference between an hypothesis and a guess. Even if I wanted to piece it together, we're still too much in the dark.
text_block_list.orig_text:
まあ仮説と当てずっぽうの想像は違うからね。
推論するにしても、
今はまだ材料が足りないか。

text_block_list.name: Labyrista
text_block_list.text: The purpose of this tower's construction... Until I can figure out the designer's intent, I don't want to mess things around and make it worse. That'd be troublesome.
text_block_list.orig_text:
この塔が造られた目的……
設計者の意図が読めないうちに変な手を出して
余計に面倒なことになっても困るし。

text_block_list.name: Labyrista
text_block_list.text: If it's really just a useless object, I can do something with it using my authority. But on the other hand, it's clear it has some connection to your memories, Boy.
text_block_list.orig_text:
本当に単なる無用の長物なら
権能でどうとでもできるけど。
どうやら少年の記憶にも関わっているって話だしなぁ。

text_block_list.name: Vampy
text_block_list.text: Heeey, isn't your "analysis" thing done already? Vampy-chan's so bored!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ねー、
『かいせき』って
まだ終わんないのー？
ヴァンピィちゃん、
つまんないー！

text_block_list.name: Labyrista
text_block_list.text: Oh, sorry, my bad. Actually, it seems that my analysis program has just finished. The floors around here are all mapped out.
text_block_list.orig_text:
っと、
ごめんごめん。
ちょうど探査プログラムも終了したみたいだ。
この付近の階層は解析し終わったよ。

text_block_list.name: Labyrista
text_block_list.text: How this tower is connected to you, Boy... Hopefully, this investigation will shed some light on that.
text_block_list.orig_text:
この塔が少年にどう関わっているのか……
今回の調査で、
少しでも手掛かりを得られるといいけど。

text_block_list.name: Labyrista
text_block_list.text: ...Looks like we have no choice but to climb higher. If we want to figure out whether this tower is useful, or dangerous, we can't stop now.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……やっぱり、
もっと上まで登るしかないか。
有益な存在か否か、
この塔を見極めるためにもね。

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: And so, aiming for the next floor, {0} and his friends kept climbing.
text_block_list.orig_text:
こうして、次の階を目指し
{0}たちは塔を登っていくのだった。
